name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Herriman One-Touch Pancake Machine & Warm Cinnamon Roll (With Eggs Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Herriman - South Jordan (Herriman, UT)
searchKeywords: holiday inn express herriman pancake machine
whyItWorks: Holiday Inn Express's signature conveyor-belt warm pancakes and famous glazed cinnamon rolls are made with refined white flour and zero nuts or seeds; pairing a single pancake or half cinnamon roll with two hard-boiled or scrambled eggs prevents an empty-stomach sugar spike.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat 1–2 hard-boiled or scrambled eggs first for protein, then enjoy a warm conveyor-belt pancake with light syrup or half a signature cinnamon roll (scrape off excess cream-cheese frosting if lactose-sensitive).
watchOuts: High sugar and dairy frosting on the cinnamon roll—save for remission and always pair with eggs or a banana
